state.block: Run the offline checks before building the package.
state.next_block: Build the package, then inspect its contents.

block_type.instructions: What structural role does `state.block` play in the supplied neighboring text? Select a role; do not rewrite the block.

criteria.heading: A section label introducing following material
criteria.list_item: One item or step in an enumeration
criteria.code: A literal code or command block
criteria.unknown: The supplied context does not support one role

ordered_step.instructions: Assuming `state.block` is a list item, is its position in a procedure semantically important? The caller must ignore this answer unless the block is actually classified as a list item.

heading_role.instructions: Assuming `state.block` is a heading, what heading role is supported by the nearby text? The caller must ignore this answer unless the block is actually classified as a heading.

criteria.document_title: The title of the whole document
criteria.section: A main section inside the document
criteria.subsection: A subdivision inside an existing section
criteria.unknown: There is not enough context to determine a heading role
